leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a basic middleware function that intercepts HTTP requests in a Node.js application
Initialize an in-memory cache object to store key-value pairs with associated timestamps
Implement cache retrieval logic that checks for existing cached data before processing requests
Configure TTL (Time-To-Live) validation to determine when cached data has expired
Apply cache population logic to store fresh data in the cache after processing requests
Integrate the cache aside middleware into an Express.js application route
Manipulate cache entries by implementing cache invalidation for expired data
lessonTitle: Build cache aside middleware with TTL
